source: GET https://api.on-demand.io/plugin/v1/list (documented Agents API, header apikey; returned HTTP 200 data.total=0 for this account — it lists account-OWNED agents only) + POST public/v1 suggest-plugins (live, returns the marketplace plugins this account can call, with logoUrl). Reference screenshot ids all confirmed present in the live suggest results.
note: logoUrl values from the API carry a SAS signature that expires (se=2026-10-14). The UI resolves favicons as live logoUrl (fetched server-side per request via /api/plugins) → logoUrlBase (unsigned CDN path, often 200) → Google s2 favicon by domain → SVG monogram.
